note: Hand-assembled in 2018 and malformed: the date string follows a length field of 0, and the payload size field says 0x2001C where 8192 bytes follow with no checksum after them, so mGBA's reader (and this converter, which follows it) cannot find the payload. The cart header names "MARIOLUIGI" without the "&" of the real title, which mGBA would refuse anyway.
